reference: open initializes the active writer and registers a distinct agent; handle close removes the agent from openedAgents
native: Repeated close of the same handle is idempotent even after another open of the agent.
Engine close serializes with open, releases cached namespace pools and rejects future opens.
Library opening requires the host-resolved baseDbPath; no implicit host path is invented.
Physical namespace pins and existing native identity validation remain mandatory; status reads only an atomic count.
coverage: Synthetic actual ProcessEngine/Lance integration, not new Node golden observations. No row authorization, recovery or readiness is inferred from open.
